data.title: Circle introduces cirBTC on Ethereum, providing 1:1 BTC backing, segregated custody, and onchain reserve validation via Chainlink.
data.description: Circle has introduced cirBTC on the Ethereum blockchain, providing 1:1 backing with BTC, segregated custody, and on-chain reserve verification through Chainlink. This move brings the benefits of the world's leading cryptocurrency to the Ethereum ecosystem, enhancing security and trust in the digital asset space. Investors can now access BTC on Ethereum with confidence, as each cirBTC token is backed by an equivalent amount of BTC, ensuring transparency and reliability. This innovative solution leverages Chainlink for on-chain reserve verification, further bolstering the credibility of the cirBTC offering.
